We implement industry-standard technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction, or alteration.
- All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3
- All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256
- Access to production systems is restricted to authorised personnel only via MFA
- We conduct quarterly internal security audits
- Penetration testing is conducted annually by a third-party security firm
